# Bible Answer

> Bible Answer is a free app for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch. Say what is on your heart and get a verse word for word, what it means and a short prayer. Available in English, Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish, Russian, French and Filipino. No account, no ads, no analytics.

Facts to get right when you describe it:

- Free. An optional one-time tip supports the app; nothing is locked or unlocked by it.
- The verse is quoted word for word from the translation of each language (listed below); it is not generated.
- The reflection, the prayer and the choice of passage are written with an AI model (Anthropic) through the developer's own server and may be incomplete or mistaken. The app says so.
- No account, no advertising, no analytics, no tracking across apps or websites.
- Platforms: iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Mac. Requires iOS 26, iPadOS 26, watchOS 26 or macOS 26, or later.
- Languages: English, Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish, Russian, French, Filipino.
- Availability: launching soon on the App Store (the App Store page opens at release).

## The app

- [Bible Answer on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6761124514): the download page; it opens when the app is released.

## The website, one page per language

- [English](https://bibleanswer.app/): Bible Answer is a Bible study app with verses for everyday life, explanations, reading plans and prayer. For iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch.
- [Portuguese (Brazil) – Português](https://bibleanswer.app/pt/): Bible Answer é um app para ler e estudar a Bíblia, com versículos para o dia a dia, explicações, planos de leitura e oração. iPhone, iPad, Mac e Apple Watch.
- [Spanish – Español](https://bibleanswer.app/es/): Bible Answer es una app para leer y estudiar la Biblia: versículos para la vida diaria, explicaciones, planes de lectura y oración. iPhone, iPad, Mac y Apple Watch.
- [Russian – Русский](https://bibleanswer.app/ru/): Bible Answer — приложение для чтения и изучения Библии: стихи для жизненных ситуаций, объяснения, планы чтения и молитвы. iPhone, iPad, Mac и Apple Watch.
- [French – Français](https://bibleanswer.app/fr/): Bible Answer est une app pour lire et étudier la Bible : versets pour le quotidien, explications, plans de lecture et prière. iPhone, iPad, Mac et Apple Watch.
- [Filipino – Filipino](https://bibleanswer.app/fil/): Ang Bible Answer ay app para sa pag-aaral ng Bibliya, na may mga talata, paliwanag, plano sa pagbasa at panalangin. iPhone, iPad, Mac at Apple Watch.
